tasks.title: auth/routes.ts: login/logout/refresh/me wired to service, contracts, cookies; throttle invoked inside service
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/routes.ts: register Hono routes `POST /api/auth.login` (zod-parses loginRequest, extracts client IP via `c.req.header('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ?? All responses Zod-parsed via contracts schemas before send. Add apps/api/src/modules/auth/dto.ts if any local mapping helper is needed. Throttle and authn middleware ordering: csrf applies to all state-changing routes but the login route MUST still allow first-time login (csrf exempt for login + refresh per ARCH §6.1).

tasks.title: auth service + repo + index: login/logout/refresh/me with scoped-to-hash replay revoke and throttle wired in
tasks.description: Author apps/api/src/modules/auth/{service.ts, repo.ts, index.ts}. repo.ts: drizzle queries — `findUserByEmail(email)` returning the user row INCLUDING password_hash (no separate credential table — password_hash lives inline on `user` per the schema change), `insertRefreshToken({ userId, tokenHash, expiresAt })`, `findRefreshTokenByHash(hash)`, `revokeRefreshToken(id)` (sets revoked_at=now() on that single row only). Do NOT export a `revokeAllActiveTokensForUser` family-sweep — replay revocation is scoped to the replayed hash. service.ts: export factory `createAuthService({ db, throttle, verifyPassword, signSessionJwt, hashRefreshToken, now, log })` returning `{ login, logout, refresh, me }`. login: first invoke `throttle.check({ ip, email })` (throws TooManyRequestsError on 11th+); then always call `verifyPassword(storedHash | dummyHash, plaintext)` exactly once even if user does not exist (constant-time per B7/B13); on failure → UnauthorizedError. refresh: SCOPED-TO-HASH SINGLE-USE — atomic transaction looks up the refresh_token row by hash; if missing OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL → mark THAT specific row revoked_at=now() (if it still exists and isn't already revoked), emit ONE `log.warn({ userId, requestId }, 'refresh_token replay detected')` line, throw UnauthorizedError. Other still-active refresh_token rows for that user remain untouched (so the user's other live sessions keep working). If valid, mark THIS row revoked_at=now() AND issue+insert a NEW refresh_token row with a fresh hash in the SAME transaction → returns new (session JWT, refresh cookie value, csrf cookie value). The transaction's update-where-not-revoked guard ensures two concurrent refreshes can't both succeed — the loser sees the row already revoked and falls into the replay branch. logout: revokes the active refresh_token row for the session. me: returns user record from ctx.user. index.ts: re-exports the factory + types only (the module's public surface).
context: ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3 — module layering: routes → service → repo → schema; index.ts is the public surface
ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4 — JWT 15min, refresh 7d HttpOnly+Secure, refresh rotated on use
Acceptance bullet B3 — auth.login returns 200 with cookies + user; 401 on bad creds
Acceptance bullet B4 — auth.refresh rotates token; replay returns 401
Acceptance bullet B5 — auth.me returns user; auth.logout clears cookies + revokes refresh row
Acceptance bullet B7 — verifyPassword called once on every login attempt (constant-time)
Acceptance bullet B13 — injectable verify (factory parameter)
Coverage gap — refresh-replay revocation is SCOPED TO THE REPLAYED HASH ONLY; other active tokens for the user remain usable; throttle wired through the service (not as Hono middleware)

tasks.title: Per-(IP, lowercased-email) rolling-window login throttle (10 attempts / 15 minutes, in-memory)
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/throttle.ts: export a factory `createLoginThrottle({ limit = 10, windowMs = 15 * 60 * 1000, now = Date.now })` returning an object with a `check({ ip, email }): void` method (called from the auth SERVICE, not as Hono middleware — per coverage requirement 'wired through the auth service'). Internally it keeps a `Map<string, number[]>` where key = `${ip}|${email.toLowerCase()}` and value = an array of attempt timestamps. On each check, prune timestamps older than `now() - windowMs` (rolling window — timestamps naturally drain as they age out), then if the remaining count >= limit, throw `TooManyRequestsError` (code TOO_MANY_REQUESTS) BEFORE the service does any password verify; otherwise push the new timestamp. The factory MUST accept an injectable `now` clock so tests can drive deterministic windows. Distinct emails on the same IP MUST NOT share a counter — the key includes the lowercased email.
context: Acceptance bullet B10 — login throttle: 11th attempt 429 without invoking argon2 verify spy
Coverage gap — rolling window keyed by ${ip}|${email.toLowerCase()} pair; wired through service

tasks.title: Hono middleware chain: requestId, logger, csrf, authn (jose HS256 pinned, 5s default skew), authz, errorHandler
tasks.description: Author the full apps/api/src/middleware/ stack. requestId.ts: assigns ctx.requestId via crypto.randomUUID(); echoes it as `X-Request-Id` response header. logger.ts: pino-http child logger bound to ctx.log; emits one line per request `{ requestId, method, path, status, durationMs, userId? }` on response close. csrf.ts: skip GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and skip routes flagged exempt (login, refresh); for other methods, compare cookie `csrf_token` to header `X-CSRF-Token` with `crypto.timingSafeEqual`; mismatch → throw ForbiddenError. authn.ts: read `session` cookie; if missing → on protected routes throw UnauthorizedError; verify JWT with `jose.jwtVerify` using algorithm PINNED via `algorithms: ['HS256']` (so HS384/HS512/etc. tokens signed with the same JWT_SECRET are rejected as UnauthorizedError); use JWT_SECRET; DO NOT override clockTolerance (jose's default of 5s applies — acceptance bullet B12); attach ctx.user = { id, email, role }. authz.ts: export `requireRole(...roles)` factory that throws ForbiddenError when ctx.user.role is not allowed. errorHandler.ts: top-level Hono onError handler — if err instanceof AppError, respond `{ error: { code, message?, details? } }` with err.statusCode; else log error and respond 500 with `{ error: { code: 'INTERNAL' } }`. Each file is one tight TypeScript module importing only from shared/ and contracts/.

tasks.title: Integration: auth.refresh rotation + replay (scoped to hash) + concurrent race + multi-session isolation
tasks.description: Create apps/api/test/integration/auth.refresh.test.ts. Cases per B4 and the scoped-replay coverage requirement: (1) login → call /api/auth.refresh with the refresh cookie → assert 200 + rotated cookies (new session, new refresh, new csrf) + the old refresh_token row has revoked_at IS NOT NULL while a fresh row exists; (2) replay path — re-send the original (already-rotated) refresh cookie → 401 AND assert via direct SQL query that the offending row has revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND the captured pino log has EXACTLY ONE warn-level entry containing both `userId` and `requestId`; (3) MULTI-SESSION ISOLATION — issue TWO independent refresh tokens for the SAME user by logging in twice from two simulated clients (sessionA, sessionB); replay the first (already-rotated) refresh from sessionA and assert 401; THEN call /api/auth.refresh with sessionB's still-active refresh cookie and assert it returns 200 with rotated cookies — proving the family of other active tokens for that user was NOT swept; (4) concurrent-refresh race — fire two parallel POST /api/auth.refresh with the same cookie via Promise.all; assert exactly one response is 200 and the other is 401.
context: Acceptance bullet B4 — refresh rotates token, replay returns 401

Coverage gap — replay revocation is SCOPED TO THE REPLAYED HASH ONLY; other active tokens for the user remain usable; multi-session test must prove a second active token still rotates after the first is replayed
